newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Financial completes initial stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Financial completes initial stock offer.

text.p: Peoples Financial Corp said Friday it completed its initial stock offering, selling 1,491,012 shares at $10 per share.
The stock was to begin trading Thursday on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market under the symbol "PFFC." By Friday morning more than 300,000 shares had been traded, going for about 10 3/4.

People's Financial is the holding company for Peoples Federal Savings and Loan Association of Massillon. The offering was made in connection with Peoples Federal's conversion from mutual to stock form, the company said.
